solidityLean.backendPath.description: Solidity Lean repository directory. Empty uses the Solidity file's workspace folder.

solidityLean.nodePath.description: Node.js executable used to launch verification.

solidityLean.verifyOnSave.description: Verify Solidity files automatically when saved.

solidityLean.automaticVerification.description: When the persistent language server verifies document snapshots. verifyOnSave overrides this setting with onsave.

solidityLean.workers.description: Maximum concurrent function/file verification workers per backend configuration. Each worker keeps its verifier runtime alive.

solidityLean.displayVerificationAsTests.description: Display verification results in the Test Explorer and editor test actions.

solidityLean.displayGutterStatus.description: Show current-version verification status beside function declarations.

solidityLean.compilerOutputDir.description: Build compiler AST artifacts under this absolute directory or path relative to the Solidity file's workspace folder. Each build uses an immutable source-named child directory. These artifacts are not proof or runtime results.

solidityLean.includePaths.description: Additional directories allowed for Solidity imports, relative to the workspace.

solidityLean.remappings.description: Solidity import remappings (prefix=target), resolved from the workspace.

solidityLean.counterexamples.description: Enable certified model prestates for certified backend requests. Direct IDE checking already searches for counterexamples. Refutations concern the verification model, not constructor reachability.

solidityLean.auditPreconditions.description: Audit possible entry states for certified backend requests. This audit is not run by direct IDE checking.

solidityLean.verificationTraceColor.description: Trace annotation colors; null uses theme defaults. Positioned trace producer is currently unavailable.
